verdict.rationale: Fellow's own feature pages say it records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings across Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. It can record with a visible bot or capture audio from the desktop without one, and users can choose when to record, pause, or resume, under organization-wide recording policies. All of this comes from vendor marketing pages only. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of capture reliability, and in-depth per-platform setup documentation.

support.subject: As a product manager, the notetaker reliably captures Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings, with recording where I want it

citations.quote: Fellow gives teams the flexibility to record with a visible bot or without one — capturing audio directly from the desktop across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack Huddles, and in-person meetings
Fellow records, transcribes, and summarizes every meeting across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Slack huddles
Users choose when to record, pause, or resume capture when part of a conversation needs to stay off the record.
Set organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained
